CODE-TABLE.description: Steel Code Checking Result Table (CODE-TABLE) for AIJ-ASD02. The D_TABLE_REQUEST DTO (wrapped in Argument) selects the code-check result table (MEMB or PROP) plus formatting and element/section filters. Prerequisites: analysis results and AIJ-ASD02 code-check results (PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO, analysis, CODE-ANAL first); without analysis results the request fails in-band with 'Please perform analysis.'. The AIJ column set is: CHK, MEMB, COM, SECT, SHR, Section, Material, Fy, LCB, Len, Lb, Ly, Lz, Cb, Ky, Kz, Pu, pPn, Muy, pMny, Muz, pMnz, Vuy, pVny, Vuz, pVnz, Def, Defa (B1y/B1z/B2y/B2z/RatPc/Tu/pTn are excluded from this code). In the RESPONSE the stress-column headers are RENAMED to AIJ labels: Cb->C, Pu->fa, pPn->Fa, Muy->fby, pMny->FBy, Muz->fbz, pMnz->FBz, Vuy->fvy, pVny->Fvy, Vuz->fvz, pVnz->Fvz (lowercase = actual/required stress, uppercase = allowable/design stress). Response shape: {<table name>: {FORCE, DIST, HEAD, DATA}}.

TABLE_TYPE.description: Table Type: MEMB (per-element rows) or PROP (per-section rows). Case-insensitive.

RESULT.description: Result View Option: 0=All 1=OK 2=NG (filters rows on the CHK column).

EXPORT_PATH.description: Save results to a file path on the HOST machine running MIDAS.

UNIT.description: Unit Settings (temporarily overrides the model units for this request).

COMPONENTS.description: Column filter list. IMPORTANT: use the INTERNAL (pre-rename, KDS-style) column names - the AIJ renaming is applied to the response HEAD only after filtering. Valid names for this endpoint: CHK, MEMB, COM, SECT, SHR, Section, Material, Fy, LCB, Len, Lb, Ly, Lz, Cb, Ky, Kz, Pu, pPn, Muy, pMny, Muz, pMnz, Vuy, pVny, Vuz, pVnz, Def, Defa. Any other name (including the AIJ display labels like 'fa' or 'FBy') ABORTS the request in-band with "'<name>' is not a valid COMPONENTS name".

PRI_SORT.description: Primary sort: 0=SECT 1=MEMB (only effective when that column is present in the output).

VIEW_RATPC.description: When true, filters OUT rows whose utilization ratio RatPc <= 0.4 (keeps only members with RatPc > 0.4). The filter still works here even though the RatPc column itself is not displayed for AIJ-ASD02. Default false = show all rows.
